entries.wants: what the up and down arrow keys do in a list of a chat's chips and actions: move the cursor to the row above or below
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, one lower-case word

entries.wants: what the enter key does on a chip (Folder, Environment, Model, Effort, Permissions): opens the list its value is changed from
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, one lower-case word

entries.wants: what the up and down arrow keys do while reading what was said in a harness session: scroll it
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, one lower-case word

entries.wants: a chat was started in another folder than the one this terminal interface was opened in, named by {folder}; it is read by opening hmz in that folder
entries.where: one line in the log of the terminal interface, two short sentences with full stops, keep {folder}
entries.text: The chat was started in {folder}. Open hmz in that folder to read it.

entries.wants: the folder has no harness session to read: no harness kept a session of its own that worked in this folder
entries.where: one short sentence with full stop, shown on the Harness session page of the terminal interface where there is nothing to read
entries.text: No harness session in this folder.
